body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/38253

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/764

## What changed

- Resolve the six GLM-5.3 linear-attention projection prefixes through the active quantization configuration instead of disabling qkvbfg fusion whenever a model-level `quant_config` exists.
- Preserve the attention-TP layout guard and reject fusion when even one source projection is quantized.
- Construct the synthetic fused projection unquantized after the source-prefix gate succeeds.
- Add a failing-before reproduction, focused regression/boundary tests, raw evidence, and the required result report.

## Reproduction and validation

```bash
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-645d11addaa7/venv/bin/python reports/j-645d11addaa7/reproduce_before.py
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-645d11addaa7/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/models/test_glm5_next_qkvbfg_fusion.py test/registered/quant/test_is_layer_skipped.py
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-645d11addaa7/venv/bin/python -m pre_commit run --files python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/utils.py python/sglang/srt/models/glm5_next.py test/registered/unit/models/test_glm5_next_qkvbfg_fusion.py
```

The focused suite passes 7 tests. On the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (`gfx950`), the actual BF16 merged and batched fused linear primitives matched independent PyTorch `linear`/`bmm` references exactly (`max_abs=0.0` for both stages).

## Limitations

The official GLM-5.3-Flash weights were unavailable, and only one GPU was assigned. Therefore this does not claim a full-model TP8 serving reproduction, semantic-accuracy qualification, or performance measurement. The GPU fixture validates the fused linear primitives only. No native source changed, so no native rebuild was required.
